added_lines: notices mass intentions first friday 6th november altar list for the dead final reminder a final reminder that if you wish to have the names of your loved ones prayed for during november and on the first friday of each month throughout the year, please write their names on the sheet provided on the table at the back of the church, and put in the envelope provided. diocesan share appeal november 7th / 8th this year’s share appeal takes place on the weekend of november 7th/8th. share is the archdiocese’s development fund, supporting parishes through financial assistance and practical services such as pastoral development, safeguarding, health and safety, and sustainability. it helps ensure that no parish is left behind and that communities can continue their mission effectively. on this share appeal sunday, we are invited to support this vital work through our generosity and ongoing commitment. candlelight liturgy of remembrance wednesday 4th 7 pm on wednesday next (november 4th at 7 pm) we will remember and pray for all those whose funerals have taken place here in st. patrick’s over the last year in a gentle liturgy of light & remembrance. this remembrance liturgy is open to all parishioners who would like to attend, and light a special votive candle in memory of their loved ones. sacrament of reconciliation (confession) the sacrament of reconciliation is a wonderful opportunity to experience god’s mercy, forgiveness and peace. fr eugen is happy to celebrate the sacrament of confession any morning before or after mass. if you would like to receive the sacrament of reconciliation, please call into the sacristy before or immediately after mass to speak with fr eugen. monkstown
